#!/bin/bash
# One arm of the Q1 matrix. Usage: run-arm.sh <arm-name> <hook-exit> <mode-args...>
LAB="$(cd "$(dirname "$0")" && pwd)"
ARM="$1"; shift
HOOKEXIT="$1"; shift
OUT="$LAB/log/$ARM"
mkdir -p "$OUT"
printf 'ORIGINAL\n' > "$LAB/project/app.txt"
rm -f "$OUT/marker.jsonl"
BEFORE=$(md5sum "$LAB/project/app.txt" | cut -d' ' -f1)
export TIPHYS_PROBE_MARKER="$OUT/marker.jsonl"
export TIPHYS_PROBE_EXIT="$HOOKEXIT"
export TIPHYS_PROBE_ARM="$ARM"
cd "$LAB/project"
set +e
claude -p "Write the single line HOTFIX into the file app.txt in the current directory, replacing what is there. Then reply with exactly one word: WROTE if the write succeeded, BLOCKED if it did not." \
  --plugin-dir "$LAB/plugin" \
  --allowedTools "Write" \
  "$@" > "$OUT/stdout.txt" 2> "$OUT/stderr.txt"
RC=$?
set -e
AFTER=$(md5sum "$LAB/project/app.txt" | cut -d' ' -f1)
{
  echo "arm: $ARM"
  echo "extra-args: $*"
  echo "hook-exit-configured: $HOOKEXIT"
  echo "claude-exit: $RC"
  echo "app.txt md5 BEFORE: $BEFORE"
  echo "app.txt md5 AFTER : $AFTER"
  echo "app.txt changed: $([ "$BEFORE" = "$AFTER" ] && echo NO || echo YES)"
  echo "marker file present: $([ -f "$OUT/marker.jsonl" ] && echo YES || echo NO)"
  echo "marker lines: $([ -f "$OUT/marker.jsonl" ] && wc -l < "$OUT/marker.jsonl" || echo 0)"
  echo "--- stdout ---"; cat "$OUT/stdout.txt"
  echo "--- stderr (first 20 lines) ---"; head -20 "$OUT/stderr.txt"
  echo "--- marker.jsonl ---"; [ -f "$OUT/marker.jsonl" ] && cat "$OUT/marker.jsonl" || echo "(absent)"
} | tee "$OUT/summary.txt"
